# Results

Isothermal titration calorimetry measurements across the pH 5-9 range revealed
a systematic dependence of substrate binding affinity on Ca2+ coordination geometry
at the MOF node [@Jones2024].

Temperature-dependent Arrhenius analysis yielded a biphasic plot with a break at
28 degrees C, indicating two kinetically distinguishable regimes [@Smith2023].

Heterologous expression in E. coli benchmarks the biological relevance of the
in vitro findings [@Brown2022].
